issue_body:
`(Airy/max(Airy,spot))²` with hardcoded `spot=5.0µm` for every singlet.
   True Strehl is `exp[−(2πσ_waves)²]`. Mislabeled placeholder surfaces in GUI.
pr_title: fix(aberrations): compute Strehl ratio from traced wavefront error
pr_body:
Replace the Airy/spot-area placeholder (with hardcoded 5um singlet spot) with the Born & Wolf pupil average S = |<exp(i*2*pi*W)>|^2 over a chief-referenced exit-pupil wavefront, shared by singlets and systems. Also report wfe_rms_waves, forward wavelength to Strehl/MTF/Airy, and cache results keyed on optical state.

Fix root causes in the wavefront chain: accumulate per-segment OPL in LensRayTracer3D.trace_surface (in-glass path was missing) and rewrite WavefrontSensor with a reference sphere on the traced paraxial focus plus piston/tilt removal and a correct terminated-ray guard.

Add tests/test_strehl.py (range, y^4 scaling, Marechal consistency, aperture monotonicity, wavelength scaling). Full suite: 698 tests OK.
